text: Hey, what are you thinking about for your future career? I’m thinking about being a graphic designer. What about you? Actually, I want to be a graphic designer, too. That’s cool. I think we’ll need to get good grades in school and do well on our design samples to get into that field. Yeah, I agree. I’ve heard that design samples are the most important part of your application. I’ve been looking at schools and it’s really competitive to get into the top programs. Yeah, it’s definitely competitive. But if we work hard and put together great samples, I’m sure we’ll get into the programs we want. Thanks, that makes me feel better. I’m working hard to make some exciting sample designs. Just take it one step at a time and don’t worry too much about it right now. We still have time to figure everything out. Yeah, you’re right. Thanks for talking with me about it. It helps to know that someone else is going through the same thing as me!
